classes.name: Tactical
classes.class_role_text: Master Tactician: A Tactical Space Marine utilizes a wide arsenal of weapons, making them accomplished at both close and ranged combat

classes.name: Assault
classes.class_role_text: Death from Above: An Assault Space Marine crushes their foes with devastating melee blows perfectly timed to ensure victory

classes.name: Vanguard
classes.class_role_text: Infiltrator: A Vanguard Space Marine specialises in liquidating vital targets in furious, close-range combat

classes.name: Bulwark
classes.class_role_text: Sword and Shield: A Bulwark Space Marine defends both the members of their Squad and the ideals of the Imperium

classes.name: Sniper
classes.class_role_text: Deadly Shadow: A Sniper Space Marine is a master of stealth who targets their enemies with pinpoint accuracy from hidden vantages

classes.name: Heavy
classes.class_role_text: Walking Strongpoint: A Heavy Space Marine's storm of firepower can devastate any enemy force with vicious efficiency

classes.name: Techmarine
classes.class_role_text: Stalwart Sentinel: A Techmarine commands automated weaponry to control the battlefield with overwhelming firepower.
